title: NX-343 UI Modernization Prompt Bundle
description: Task generator prompts to drive the UI inventory, mapping, component library, backlog, and compliance deliverables for Nexus.

owner.description: Team or AI using the prompts.

source_repos.description: Repositories the automation must read when generating artifacts.

metadata.notes: Run prompts sequentially; reuse intermediate outputs when possible.

prompts.title: Generate canonical UI inventory JSON
prompts.goal: Produce a complete list of UI surfaces across legacy repositories to guide migration planning.
prompts.instructions: Crawl and statically analyze the AgOpenGPS V6 repo, the AgOpenGPS-dev repo, and the Avalonia port. For each top-level screen or dialog, output an object with: unique id, screen name, description, repo path(s) to primary source file(s), menu hierarchy, toolbar buttons, dialogs triggered, settings panels, and whether the element is presentation-only or bound to domain logic (steering, section control, mapping, etc.). Capture screenshot file names if available and include text descriptions when screenshots cannot be produced. Return a JSON array sorted by screen name.
acceptance_criteria: Every screen listed includes menu/toolbar context and file paths.
Each entry flags whether domain logic is involved.
Screenshots or text descriptions exist for all entries.
JSON validates against the schema defined in schemas/ui-inventory.schema.json if available.

prompts.title: Export UI inventory CSV
prompts.goal: Provide a spreadsheet-friendly summary of the UI inventory entries.
prompts.instructions: Convert ui-inventory.json into CSV format. Columns: id, screen, element_type (menu|dialog|panel|toolbar|widget), primary_action, secondary_actions, dependencies (library/plugin/proc), likely_plugin_owner. Where multiple values exist, separate with semicolons. Persist to artifacts/ui-inventory.csv.
acceptance_criteria: CSV rows align one-to-one with ui-inventory.json entries.
Dependencies column references concrete package or plugin names.
File encoded in UTF-8 with headers on first row.

prompts.title: Assign UI elements to core or plugin hosts
prompts.goal: Define the ownership of each UI element so plugins can inject their surfaces.
prompts.instructions: Using ui-inventory.json, create ui-to-plugin.yaml mapping each screen/element to either `core` or a plugin slug (e.g., plugin:section-control). Include inject_point (menu slot, settings region, toolbar zone) and a proposed capability contract id (e.g., section_control.v1). Flag uncertain assignments with `review: true`.
acceptance_criteria: Every ui-inventory id appears exactly once.
Inject points reference core shell regions (menu, toolbar, settings.plugins, leftNav, map.overlay).
Capability contract ids follow kebab or dot notation and match planned gRPC/JSON contracts.
YAML parses cleanly with standard tooling.

prompts.title: Author Avalonia design system specification
prompts.goal: Describe reusable components and theme tokens required for the Nexus UI shell.
prompts.instructions: From the inventory and mapping files, synthesize a component specification for the @nexus/ui-core library. For each component (AppShell, LeftNav, TopToolbar, SettingsLayout, MapCanvas controls, form inputs, dialogs, icons), document props/parameters, state management expectations, plugin injection hooks, and references back to ui-inventory entries. Output Markdown plus a machine-readable JSON theme token file capturing typography, spacing, radius, and color scales for light/dark modes.
acceptance_criteria: Spec lists component complexity (Low/Medium/High).
Each component references relevant inventory ids.
Theme tokens cover typography, color (surface/primary/accent/state), spacing, radii, stroke widths.
Markdown includes example XAML snippets or pseudo-code.

prompts.title: Generate GitHub-ready backlog
prompts.goal: Create granular implementation tasks derived from the UI mapping and component spec.
prompts.instructions: Produce a JSON array compatible with the GitHub Issues import API. For each task: include title, body (summary, context, acceptance criteria), labels (ui, avalonia, plus plugin:<name> where applicable), estimated complexity, and suggested file paths. Group tasks into epics (shell-and-navigation, settings-and-plugins, mapping-and-canvas, section-control, autosteer, dialogs-and-wizards). Reference ui-inventory ids and component names explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: At least 100 tasks generated across epics.
Each task contains acceptance criteria in checklist format.
Tasks cite required contracts or plugin manifests when relevant.
JSON validates against GitHub issues import schema.
Include sample PR description templates for major epics.

prompts.title: Produce license compliance checklist
prompts.goal: Ensure reuse of legacy assets respects licensing constraints.
prompts.instructions: Scan the LICENSE files from each legacy repository and summarize obligations. Output a Markdown checklist covering attribution requirements, incompatible assets, steps to recreate icons/art, and verification steps before merging plugin UI ports. Include boilerplate attribution text for MIT, GPL, or custom licenses discovered.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist enumerates each repo with license type.
Explicitly lists assets that must be recreated.
Provides attribution boilerplate and instructions for THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES updates.
Includes diff checklist to confirm no proprietary code is imported.
